article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 70% Indica / 30% Sativa
Genetics: GG4 × Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies
Breeder: Barney’s Farm
THC Content: 29–32%
CBD Content: 1%
Terpene Profile: Beta-caryophyllene , limonene , myrcene
Primary Flavors: Sour diesel, key lime, walnut, earth
Flowering Time (Indoor): 60–70 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: Beginning of October
Indoor Yield: 700–800 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 2,000–3,000 g per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Glookies brings together two cannabis families that helped shape an entire generation of American weed: the sticky, fuel-heavy potency of GG4 and the dessert-like complexity of Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. Barney’s Farm combined those influences into an indica-dominant hybrid that manages to smell simultaneously aggressive and refined. Sour diesel and earthy resin provide the foundation, but key lime, roasted nuts, sweetness, and faint cookie dough give the aroma a more unusual personality than a typical Glue cross.

The plant itself is equally distinctive, developing extensive side branching, large resinous flowers, and enough production potential to interest serious indoor and outdoor growers. Potency is formidable, reaching roughly 29–32% THC in breeder material, yet the effects are not limited to heavy sedation. An energetic, motivational beginning can remain surprisingly functional before the cultivar gradually reveals its deeper indica character.
Genetics and Lineage

Barney’s Farm created Glookies by crossing GG4 with Original Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. GG4, formerly known as Gorilla Glue #4 and now widely called Original Glue , contributes some of the most recognizable traits in the hybrid. The famous GG4 cut traces to Chem’s Sister, Sour Dubb, and Chocolate Diesel , a combination responsible for powerful fuel aromas, sour earth, vigorous branching, extreme trichome production, and high THC potential. Its flowers became famous for leaving trimming equipment and fingers coated in sticky resin, a characteristic that transfers strongly into many Glue descendants.

Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies contributes a very different style of complexity. A prized expression of the broader Girl Scout Cookies family , Thin Mint is associated with OG Kush and Durban -derived ancestry and is valued for dense flower structure, sweet baked-goods notes, minty freshness, earth, spice, and a strong combination of cerebral and physical effects. Within Glookies, that parent softens some of GG4’s raw diesel character while adding sweetness, nutty depth, citrus-like brightness, and greater aromatic range.

The finished cross is roughly 70% indica and 30% sativa, but the genetic ratio does not translate into a simple sedative strain. GG4 contributes considerable vigor and mental energy, while Thin Mint adds both euphoria and physical calm. Barney’s Farm selected the hybrid for high THC, extensive branching, heavy flower production, and the unusual sour-diesel, key-lime, and walnut flavor combination. Those traits make Glookies more than a renamed Glue hybrid; it has enough Cookies influence to create its own recognizable identity.
Effects and Experience

The beginning can feel unexpectedly active. Rather than immediately producing couch-lock, moderate amounts often create a rapid lift in mood accompanied by greater mental engagement. Conversation may become easier, music more immersive, and routine activities somewhat more enjoyable. There can also be a motivational quality during this stage, making the cultivar unusual among very high-THC indica-dominant marijuana strains . Experienced consumers may find that smaller servings work well when they want strong effects without abandoning whatever they were doing beforehand.

Physical weight builds underneath that cerebral activity rather than replacing it instantly. Muscles begin to loosen, tension becomes less noticeable, and the body gradually settles into a calmer state. The transition can create a comfortable middle ground in which the mind remains interested while the body feels distinctly relaxed. Social evenings, gaming, movies, music, and creative hobbies fit this phase particularly well because they require engagement without demanding perfect concentration or coordination.

High doses reveal a very different side of Glookies. With THC potentially reaching the low 30% range, excessive consumption can rapidly turn motivation into heaviness and mental intensity into fog. Couch-lock, appetite stimulation, and sleepiness may appear later in the session. Dry mouth and dry eyes are common possibilities, while THC-sensitive consumers may experience dizziness, racing thoughts, or temporary anxiety. The cultivar’s strength makes careful dosing far more useful than simply consuming as much as possible.
Medical Benefits

The balance between early mental uplift and later physical relaxation may interest medical cannabis consumers who want more versatility than a purely sedating indica. Stress and mental fatigue are two areas where the initial effects may be relevant. A noticeable shift in mood can temporarily redirect attention away from repetitive thoughts, while the slower development of body relaxation allows the experience to remain relatively functional for part of the session.

As physical effects deepen, persistent aches, muscular tension, and general discomfort may become less intrusive. THC affects pain perception through the endocannabinoid system and several related neurological pathways, although response depends heavily on dose and individual physiology. Glookies contains very little CBD, so the effect is overwhelmingly THC-driven compared with balanced medical marijuana cultivars.

The later stage may also appeal to consumers dealing with poor appetite or difficulty settling down before sleep. Beta-caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene, and other terpenes contribute additional complexity to the flower, with caryophyllene particularly notable because it can interact with CB2 cannabinoid receptors. Individual terpenes should not be treated as guaranteed medical treatments, however. People using weed therapeutically should consider actual laboratory results, personal THC sensitivity, medication interactions, and professional medical guidance when appropriate.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Glookies avoids the predictable sweetness found in many Cookies descendants. Sour diesel frequently makes the first impression, releasing a pungent fuel-like smell as soon as cured flowers are disturbed. That intensity is quickly joined by key lime, producing a sharp citrus quality that can resemble fresh lime peel rather than sugary lemon candy. Underneath both sits an unusual nutty note often compared with walnuts, along with earth, herbs, and a softer cookie-like sweetness inherited from Thin Mint.

Beta-caryophyllene contributes warm pepper, wood, and spice, while limonene supports the lime and citrus qualities. Myrcene can deepen the aroma with earth, musk, and herbs. Some phenotypes also reveal pine or dry hop-like characteristics associated with pinene and humulene. Because cultivation conditions influence terpene production, one plant may lean heavily toward diesel and earth while another expresses noticeably more lime, nuts, and sweetness.

The flavor develops in a similarly layered way. Sour fuel and lime often arrive first, followed by creamy earth and roasted nuts through the middle of the inhale. The exhale can reveal more Cookies influence, leaving sweet dough, mild spice, and diesel lingering together. Vaporization tends to preserve the brighter lime and nutty details, while combustion emphasizes fuel, earth, and pepper. A slow cure is especially worthwhile because overdried flower can lose the citrus top notes and become overwhelmingly diesel-heavy.
Growing Information

Glookies develops extensive lateral branching and can fill horizontal space quickly when given adequate vegetative time. Indoors, plants generally finish around 100–120 centimeters tall, making the strain manageable in standard grow rooms despite its vigorous structure. Outdoor plants commonly reach approximately 120–180 centimeters. The branching habit makes canopy training particularly useful because numerous side shoots are capable of supporting substantial flowers rather than functioning merely as secondary growth.

Topping early can create multiple strong leaders, while low-stress training helps spread those branches across the available light footprint. Screen of Green cultivation is an especially logical choice because the plant naturally produces enough side growth to fill a net efficiently. Interior shoots that remain shaded can be removed before flowering, redirecting energy toward productive tops while increasing air movement through the canopy.

Indoor flowering generally lasts 60–70 days. Flowers become large and increasingly resinous during the later stages, with GG4 ancestry particularly evident in the quantity of trichomes spreading over calyxes and nearby sugar leaves. Dense buds and strong resin production make late-flower environmental control important. Humidity should be kept moderate and air allowed to circulate freely around the canopy to reduce the chance of moisture becoming trapped within mature flowers.

Barney’s Farm lists indoor yield potential around 700–800 grams per square meter under ideal conditions, placing Glookies among its more productive high-potency cultivars. Reaching those figures requires an evenly illuminated canopy, healthy roots, stable irrigation, appropriate nutrition, and enough vegetative growth to fill the available space. Overfeeding is unnecessary; vigorous plants generally perform better when nutrition increases gradually in response to visible demand rather than being pushed aggressively from the beginning.

Outdoors, production can become enormous. Under exceptional conditions, mature specimens may reach 2,000–3,000 grams per plant. Such numbers require long vegetative growth, substantial root volume, uninterrupted sunlight, careful irrigation, and a favorable climate rather than simply planting a seed and allowing it to grow unattended. Large plants should be supported before flowers gain maximum weight because productive lateral branches can bend significantly late in the season.

Outdoor harvest normally falls during the first or second week of October in Northern Hemisphere gardens. Regions with dry, sunny early autumn weather are ideal because dense flowers are easier to finish safely without persistent rain. Resin output also makes the cultivar highly attractive for concentrate production. Trichome-rich trim and smaller flowers can provide excellent material for dry sift, ice-water hash, or rosin, particularly when plants are harvested and dried with terpene preservation in mind.
FAQ
What strains make Glookies?

Glookies was created by Barney’s Farm from GG4 crossed with Original Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. GG4 contributes Chem, Sour, and Diesel ancestry along with exceptional resin production and pungent fuel aromas. Thin Mint adds Cookies-family sweetness, earth, spice, density, and a more refined dessert-like quality.
Is Glookies indica or sativa?

The cultivar is approximately 70% indica and 30% sativa. Its growth pattern and later body effects reflect the indica majority, but the initial experience can feel surprisingly energetic, euphoric, and motivational. Physical relaxation becomes stronger as the high continues.
How much THC is in Glookies?

Current Barney’s Farm material lists THC around 29% in the U.S. catalog and as high as approximately 32% in other current breeder material. Actual harvested cannabis can test differently depending on phenotype, lighting, plant health, maturity, drying, curing, and laboratory methodology. Regardless of the exact percentage, Glookies belongs in the high-potency category.
What does Glookies taste like?

Sour diesel, key lime, walnuts, earth, spice, and sweet Cookies notes form the core profile. The unusual combination of citrus and roasted-nut flavors differentiates it from many other GG4 hybrids, which often remain dominated by fuel and sour earth.
How long does Glookies take to flower?

Indoor flowering generally takes approximately 60–70 days. Outdoor plants normally mature during the first or second week of October in suitable Northern Hemisphere climates. Growers should still examine trichome development, flower swelling, plant health, and local weather before choosing the exact harvest date.
Final Thoughts on Glookies

Glookies works because GG4 and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies contribute different strengths without cancelling one another. GG4 supplies explosive resin production, sour fuel, vigorous branching, and heavy potency, while Thin Mint introduces sweet Cookies depth, spice, lime-like brightness, and a denser dessert character. The resulting marijuana has enough of both parents to be recognizable without tasting or growing exactly like either one.

Its effects follow the same pattern of contrast. Early motivation and euphoria make the strain feel more animated than many 70% indica hybrids, yet deeper physical relaxation gradually develops as the session continues. At modest doses, that balance can remain surprisingly versatile. At heavier amounts, THC approaching 30% or more can transform the experience into substantial body weight and reduced motivation.

Cultivators receive one of the more productive combinations of Glue and Cookies genetics available from a major breeder. Indoor plants remain reasonably compact while developing extensive side branching, 60–70 day flowering keeps the production cycle manageable, and yields can approach 700–800 g/m². Outdoors, properly established plants can become exceptionally productive before their early-October finish.

For consumers interested in powerful modern weed without another interchangeable candy profile, Glookies offers something distinctive. Sour diesel, key lime, walnuts, earth, and Cookies sweetness create a flavor combination that is difficult to confuse with most contemporary hybrids. Combined with extreme resin, high THC potential, and a cerebral-to-relaxed effect, those qualities give Glookies an identity strong enough to stand beside the two famous parents that created it.
